business_goal: Deliver the Item Notes feature for the E-commerce application.
scope: Allow registered users to add a short text note to a catalog item.
Display all notes for a catalog item, sorted by creation date (newest first).
out_of_scope: Notes on items not accessible to the user.

functional_requirements.description: Users can add a short text note to a catalog item and view every note left on that item, newest first.

non_functional_requirements.description: The system shall support up to 100 notes per item.
The system shall ensure that note content is sanitized to prevent XSS attacks.

user_stories.goal: I want to add a note to a product item so that I can share my thoughts or observations.
user_stories.benefit: It enhances personalization and engagement with product details.

user_stories.goal: I want to see all notes on a product item, newest first, so that I can understand recent feedback or comments.
user_stories.benefit: It provides transparency and community insights on product usage.

acceptance_criteria.description: A user can successfully submit a note for an item and see it appear in the list.
Notes are displayed in descending order of creation date.
The system prevents submission of notes exceeding 500 characters.

input_requirements: Text input for note content (max 500 characters).
output_requirements: List of notes associated with an item.
Individual note details including content, author, and timestamp.
ui_expectations: A text input field for adding a note.
A section displaying all notes for an item, sorted newest first.
Note content should be displayed with author and timestamp.

validation_rules.description: Note content must not exceed 500 characters.
Only registered users can submit notes.

constraints: Notes must be stored in a relational database with proper indexing on item_id and created_at.
assumptions: UI expectations were inferred from functional requirements.
API endpoints were inferred based on CRUD actions for notes on items.
User authentication is handled by the application's existing auth layer.
risks: Potential performance degradation with large numbers of notes per item.
Security risk from unsanitized note content.
